scope: Local source only; no deploy, cloud calls/auth, resources, grants, verification or selected-content execution.

aws.review.s3.selected_source_secret_ind.observed: Both completed offline detectors with bound conditional reads yield PASS for clean supported text. A trusted hit yields FAIL, including later incomplete coverage; unreadable, malformed, denied, foreign or unbound no-hit inputs stay UNKNOWN.
aws.review.s3.selected_source_secret_ind.native_transport: Actual collect_snapshot -> unchanged collect_live dispatcher -> aws.collect -> production Requests.call/client -> real botocore signed native HTTP/XML/JSON/header parsers and StreamingBody -> public evaluate_snapshot. No Requests/client/registry draft bridge remains.
permissions: STS GetCallerIdentity; no IAM allow required
s3:GetObject for current object HEAD/GET or s3:GetObjectVersion for selected existing version
Already applicable encryption/key permissions; no direct KMS operation or additional grant

current_native_cases.origin: Independent actual production collect_snapshot -> aws.collect -> Requests/client -> native signed botocore HTTP/StreamingBody -> public evaluate_snapshot. PASS/FAIL both real pinned offline engines; denied native GetObject UNKNOWN. Exact unwrapped consumer item/index captured, dependency-only projection omits unrelated not-selected inventories/metadata; no invented facts or CASES provider inputs.

runtime_changes.Requests.client: One selected S3 profile client configuration plus fixed regional STS bootstrap only when S3 is internally named and content flag true; custom endpoint overrides cannot redirect this selected source chain.
runtime_changes.Requests.call: Exact S3-only early delegation after initialized/named/flag guard; no unknown-operation fallback or generic GetObject permission. Raw S3 bodies never enter generic Future cache. Actual SDK invocation for four existing explicit content profiles and STS is wrapped in private_sdk_logs; ordinary unrelated metadata logging remains available.
runtime_changes.aws.collect: Typed selectors checked before auth, state initialized once, optional kind excluded by default, exact regional job dispatch, final union-redaction/cache-alias cleanup before snapshot serialization.
runtime_changes.engine: AWS typed selector validation, named-check-derived internal kind and optional full-default exclusion. Inventory/collect-all/private-kind spoof cannot enable application-data reads without exact named check and flag.
runtime_changes.hosted_UI: S3 option is allowed with strict early target validation and AWS help text; hosted unknown internal fields remain prohibited. Root owns canonical row/presentation/browser integration.
runtime_changes.registry: One guarded atomic helper/receipt/native CASES installed with distinct registry hook after receipt/cases were prepared; no predecessor evaluator/CASES/source pin edited.

sdk_privacy.protected_auth: Ordinary STS GetCallerIdentity and uncached AssumeRole native success and error responses/headers are private within Requests.call; no session-flow redesign.
sdk_privacy.native_debug_proof: Independent real botocore HTTP success/403 fixtures for all four content profiles and both STS paths. Supported package ZIP download is memory-only fake trusted native HTTP; no remote reference fetch. Completed projections and safe cache/error state checked, not merely status registration.
sdk_privacy.concurrency: Original accepted S3 native helper cases prove other-thread logging and overlapping contexts remain independent and restore filters; current native DEBUG success/denial proves production invocation boundary.
sdk_privacy.limit: Only these explicit content profiles and STS receive SDK log suppression; other ordinary metadata logging is preserved as requested.

default_role.semantics: HeadObject maps to GetObject permission; GetObjectVersion is a conditional permission on native GetObject with VersionId, not an invented SDK operation. Both new read descriptors are explicitly UNGRANTED by metadata role generation. No active IAM template generated or edited.
